_comment: Catalog of every placeholder the legal documents may use. 'default' of the form '@other.key' means 'same as other.key'. 'required' keys have no usable default: the host must configure them. Defaults marked verify:true are starting points, check them with counsel for your jurisdiction.

company.address.label: Full postal address on one line

company.legal_email.label: Legal notices, abuse, copyright, DSA contact (defaults to company.email)

product.name.label: Brand / service name (defaults to the company name)

dpo.email.label: DPO contact; leave empty if none appointed

policy.min_age.label: Minimum age to use the service (also the age below which we do not knowingly hold data)

policy.notice_days.label: Advance notice for material changes and new sub-processors (days)

policy.breach_hours.label: Hours within which we notify customers of a personal-data breach (as processor)

policy.liability_cap_months.label: Liability cap = fees paid in the last N months (business customers)

policy.claim_months.label: Time limit to raise claims (months), where the law allows

policy.retention_account_days.label: Days after account closure before deletion

feature.consumers.label: Service is offered to consumers (not only businesses)

feature.processor_role.label: You process personal data on behalf of business customers (DPA applies)

table.subprocessors.label: Markdown table of sub-processors (name, purpose, location)

table.cookies.label: Markdown table of cookies / storage items

company.imprint_extra.label: Free text added to the legal notice: register court/number, phone, legal form, chamber, regulated-trade info

eu_rep.label: EU representative (Art. 27 GDPR): name, address, email on one line; empty if not needed

uk_rep.label: UK representative: name, address, email on one line; empty if not needed

law.authority.label: Lead data-protection authority (default comes from law.jurisdiction)

consumer_dispute.label: Consumer dispute-resolution body you participate in, if any

feature.mobile.label: Mobile / desktop apps distributed through app stores

feature.game.label: Games or game-like experiences (virtual items, fair play, end of service)

feature.minors.label: Users below the age of majority are allowed with parent/guardian consent (set policy.min_age to the minimum, e.g. 13)

license.id.label: Licence this project/content is released under (id from licenses/catalog.json, e.g. MIT, AGPL-3.0-only, LicenseRef-Proprietary); empty = no licence page. Pick one with tools/license.php

license.year.label: Copyright year or range for the notice (default: current year)

license.holder.label: Copyright holder named in the licence

license.notice.label: Extra parameters shown above the licence text, e.g. BUSL Licensor / Change Date / Change License / Additional Use Grant

license.name.label: Licence name (filled in from the catalogue)

license.spdx.label: SPDX identifier (filled in from the catalogue)

license.url.label: Canonical URL (filled in from the catalogue)

license.summary.label: One-line summary (filled in from the catalogue)

license.text.label: Full licence text (filled in from the catalogue)

law.jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction id for governing law, venue and authority (rs, hr, ba, me, gb, de); or set law.governing/venue/authority yourself

computed._comment: Supplied by the plugin, not by site config.
computed.doc.title: title from front matter
computed.url.<doc id>: site URL where that document is published, e.g. url.privacy, url.terms, url.acceptable_use
